pr_title: Adjust minimum triangle movement speed to avoid "static" triangles in logo

issue_context.title: In main menu on osu! logo some little triangle(s) moves too slow
issue_context.body:
So, the problem is already described in title. I tried to restart the client but this triangle (sometimes one, sometimes two) spawns anyway at different places.
Video:

https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/47123924/131412211-9d979618-015b-474a-829c-84ab39a65693.mp4
comments: This is actually "correct" by implementation, but I agree it looks a bit weird. We probably should be limiting how small the triangles that spawn should be, or limiting the minimum velocity. Likely the first?
Any reason for closing? the corresponding PR is still not merged.

Oh, sorry, I am a newbie on GitHub. I thought if peppy wrote a fix, the issue should be closed.
